name: Van Hilleary
summary: William Vanderpool "Van" Hilleary (born June 20, 1959) is an American politician who served as the U.S. representative for Tennessee's 4th congressional district from 1995 to 2003. He is a member of the Republican Party. He is running for congress in 2026 for Tennessee's 6th congressional district to succeed U.S. Representative John Rose.
